indicator_name: FAO Food Price Index and its sub-indices (meat, dairy, cereals, vegetable oils, sugar), 2014-2016 = 100, monthly
description: Индекс продовольственных цен ФАО и его составляющие (мясо, молочная продукция, зерновые, растительные масла, сахар), 2014-2016 = 100, помесячно
methodology: FAO, nominal indices from 1990-01, released the first Friday of the month; the last two or three months are revised. September 2026: FFPI 135.6 (meat 127.1, dairy 119.1, cereals 122.3, oils 198.6, sugar 113.7); October 2026 133.9. The real (deflated) indices are in the xlsx on the FAO page and are not kept.
